understanding: Implement passive observers for modem_control_if on rts_pad_o dtr_pad_o cts_pad_i dsr_pad_i ri_pad_i dcd_pad_i and uart_interrupt on int_o with analysis ports for status and interrupt comparison after bring-up clock and reset order. baud_output has no RTL port and no agent and is retained as unsupported without driving or sampling.
preconditions: WAIT for clock stable at SYM_CLK_PERIOD and reset deasserted plus SYM_IDLE_CYCLES before enabling observers
ASSUME wishbone_bus owns wb_adr_i wb_dat_i wb_we_i wb_stb_i wb_cyc_i wb_sel_i and observes wb_dat_o wb_ack_o
ASSUME serial_data owns srx_pad_i and observes stx_pad_o
ASSUME modem_control_if owns cts_pad_i dsr_pad_i ri_pad_i dcd_pad_i and observers tap rts_pad_o dtr_pad_o plus inputs passively
ASSUME uart_interrupt observes int_o passively and drives nothing
ASSUME monitors drive no DUT inputs and provide analysis ports for scoreboard plumbing
check_steps: SAMPLE rts_pad_o dtr_pad_o cts_pad_i dsr_pad_i ri_pad_i dcd_pad_i on clock and PUBLISH modem_status_event to analysis port without driving
SAMPLE int_o level on clock and on transition PUBLISH interrupt_event to analysis port without driving
IF reset asserted THEN FLUSH partial modem and interrupt events and WAIT for deassertion plus SYM_IDLE_CYCLES before resuming SAMPLE
COMPARE observed int_o level against IIR bit0 value from wishbone_bus read to qualify pending versus no-pending
CHECK observed int_o assertion only when corresponding IER bit among 0-3 is enabled as programmed via wishbone_bus
coverage_steps: SAMPLE cg_interrupt from uart_interrupt analysis port covering IIR pending versus no-pending and IER bits 0-3 combinations including all-disabled
SAMPLE cg_modem from modem_control_if analysis port covering each pin toggle and combined status change
completion: WAIT for modem and interrupt event queues to drain within TEST_TIMEOUT_CYCLES operational limit not DUT timing
CLEANUP release observer handles and leave DUT pins to owners with monitors driving nothing

facts.statement: IER enables and disables interrupt generation by the UART.
facts.quote: This register allows enabling and disabling interrupt generation by the UART.

facts.statement: IER bit 0 controls Received Data available interrupt disabled when 0 enabled when 1.
IER bit 1 controls Transmitter Holding Register empty interrupt.
facts.quote: 1 RW Transmitter Holding Register empty interrupt

facts.statement: IER bit 2 controls Receiver Line Status Interrupt.
IER bit 3 controls Modem Status Interrupt.
IIR bit 0 reports interrupt pending when 0.
facts.quote: Bit 0 indicates that an interrupt is pending when it’s logic ‘0’.

facts.statement: IIR reports no interrupt pending when 1.
